description: Add packages and options to the computer's NixOS configuration or the person's Home Manager configuration (flakes) and rebuild it

name.description: The app's name in furnish's local flake; unique on the computer

packages.description: Packages from the configuration's nixpkgs, by attribute name (environment.systemPackages or home.packages)

options.description: NixOS options by name, e.g. programs.htop.enable: true

homeOptions.description: Home Manager options by name, used instead of options when the app goes into Home Manager

onlyIfSetUp.description: Apply the step only where its configuration is set up for furnish; elsewhere furnish skips it, as for a false condition

managedBy.description: The configuration that already supplies this step's options outside furnish

declaredIn.description: Folder of the configuration that supplies these options

installedInto.description: Where the app is: the NixOS configuration or Home Manager

_exist.description: Whether the app should be in the configuration

_metadata.description: What-if details: the steps a set would perform
